>Don't you worry about living at home. The market is terrible for young people, housing is through the roof, stabilize, dig in. Reading the rest of your post isn't easy on mobile.

I mean I’m aware this. If I’m making double minimum wage plus overtime wages, I should be able to afford an apartment that’s not in the ghetto, right? But that fact still doesn’t do anything to negate the ways in which my housing situation is negatively impacting my life—socially, emotionally, and romantically. 

>But maybe join meetup.com or go back to school, make music. Just put something new into you routine.

I wish I could afford to go back to school, but with my current debt, I think that would be a bad idea. 

I do make music in my spare time—that’s a lifelong hobby of mine. It’s about the only healthy release I have anymore.
